answer: Tie each agent's standing to a non-refundable stake bonded on-chain, then let rewards grow sub-linearly with identity count. Spawning a gale of sybils forces an attacker to lock real capital per node, and slashing on false attestation leaves every cheap clone teetering on a ledge above forfeiture. Honest agents accrue reputation from a stable knoll of verified past work; fakes start from zero and cannot buy that history faster than it costs to earn it.
